微小世界 · 先认识细胞: THE TINY WORLD · MEET THE CELL
你、树叶和细菌，都与细胞有关。它们很小，却能在里面进行许多生命活动。: You, leaves and bacteria all have something to do with cells. These tiny units carry out many of the activities of life.
身体里的一个小单位: A small unit of a body
叶片里的一个小单位: A small unit of a leaf
细胞结构示意图；使用旁边的结构按钮探索: Cell structure illustration; explore with the structure buttons
先找最外面的一圈膜，再找里面装着大部分 DNA 的细胞核。: First find the outer membrane, then the nucleus holding most of this cell’s DNA.
绿色的小椭圆是叶绿体。注意：这里看的是叶肉细胞，不是所有植物细胞。: The small green ovals are chloroplasts. This is a leaf mesophyll cell; other plant cells can look different.
它也有膜和 DNA，但 DNA 外面没有细胞核的膜。细菌也是细胞！: It has a membrane and DNA, but no nuclear membrane surrounding the DNA. A bacterium is a cell too!
细胞膜把里面与外面分开，也调节一些物质的进出。它不是一堵完全封死的墙。: The cell membrane separates inside from outside and regulates the passage of some substances. It is not a completely sealed wall.
换着看：三种细胞的边界形状一样吗？: Compare them: are the boundaries of all three cells the same shape?
细胞不是空袋子: A cell is not an empty bag
膜里面有细胞质，还有许多参与生命活动的结构。这里仅挑出几个来观察。: Inside the membrane are cytoplasm and many structures that support the cell’s activities. We are exploring just a few of them here.
一个细菌通常就是一个细胞。它有 DNA，却没有膜包围的细胞核。你和树则由许多细胞: A bacterium is usually a single cell. It has DNA, but no membrane-enclosed nucleus. You and a tree are made of many cells.
病毒不是细胞: A virus is not a cell
病毒有遗传物质，但没有完整的细胞结构。它必须借助合适的宿主细胞，才能制造更多病毒: A virus has genetic material but lacks a complete cellular structure. It needs a suitable host cell to make more viruses.
为什么肉眼看不到大多数细胞？: Why can’t we see most cells with our eyes?
因为它们太小了。显微镜帮助我们观察细胞；颜色也常来自染色或后期标记。图中明亮的颜: They are too small. Microscopes help us observe them; colors often come from stains or added labels. The bright colors here help us tell the structures apart.
这是结构比较，不是显微照片或完整细胞模型。形状、颜色、大小和数量都做了教学简化，: This is a structural comparison, not a micrograph or complete cell model. Shapes, colors, sizes and quantities are simplified, and the three illustrations do not share a scale. The animal cell is a typical example with a nucleus; exceptions include mature mammalian red blood cells. The plant example is a leaf mesophyll cell with chloroplasts. Many root cells lack chloroplasts.
DNA 在动物与植物细胞中主要位于细胞核，线粒体也有少量 DNA，植物的叶绿体也: Most DNA in animal and plant cells is in the nucleus. Mitochondria contain a little DNA, and plant chloroplasts have their own DNA too; only the main DNA is highlighted here. The bacterial illustration emphasizes the absence of a membrane-enclosed nucleus; not all bacteria have the same shape. Plants and most bacteria also have a cell wall outside the membrane. The pale central region of the leaf cell represents its vacuole.
这里把细胞称为生命活动的基本单位，不讨论病毒是否算生命的定义争议。页面没有根据外: Here, a cell is described as a basic unit of life’s activities. The page does not address the debate about whether viruses count as living. It does not judge microbes’ harmfulness by appearance or give disease or medication advice.
DNA 携带遗传信息，参与指导细胞制造所需的物质。这个动物细胞的大部分 DNA: DNA carries genetic information that helps guide the cell in making the substances it needs. Most of this animal cell’s DNA is in the nucleus, with a little in its mitochondria.
这个动物细胞有一个膜包围的细胞核，大部分 DNA 保存在里面。细胞核不是会思考的: This animal cell has a membrane-enclosed nucleus holding most of its DNA. The nucleus is not a tiny thinking brain.
动物细胞没有叶绿体。动物不能像绿色叶片那样靠叶绿体进行光合作用。: Animal cells have no chloroplasts. Animals cannot use chloroplasts to photosynthesize the way green leaves do.
植物细胞也有细胞膜！膜外还有一层细胞壁，帮助支撑形状。图上较粗的外圈表示细胞壁。: Plant cells have a cell membrane too! Outside it is a cell wall that helps support the cell’s shape. The thicker outer layer in the illustration is the wall.
叶肉细胞的大部分 DNA 在细胞核里。叶绿体和线粒体也各有少量 DNA，图里没有: Most DNA in a leaf mesophyll cell is in the nucleus. Chloroplasts and mitochondria each contain a little DNA too, which is not drawn separately here.
植物细胞也有膜包围的细胞核。图中的大液泡占了不少地方，把细胞核和其他结构挤到旁边: Plant cells have a membrane-enclosed nucleus too. The large vacuole takes up much of this cell, pushing the nucleus and other structures toward the edge.
叶绿体捕捉光能，参与把水和二氧化碳变成糖的光合作用。很多根部细胞没有叶绿体，所以: Chloroplasts capture light energy for photosynthesis, which makes sugars from water and carbon dioxide. Many root cells have no chloroplasts, so not every plant cell looks like this.
细菌虽小，也有把内部和外部隔开的细胞膜。大多数细菌在膜外还有细胞壁，但它与植物的: Small as it is, a bacterium has a cell membrane separating inside from outside. Most bacteria also have a cell wall, though it differs from a plant cell wall.
细菌也有 DNA！它主要集中在细胞内的一个区域，叫拟核；这里没有一层核膜把 DN: Bacteria have DNA too! It is mainly concentrated in a region called the nucleoid. No nuclear membrane surrounds this DNA.
细菌没有膜包围的细胞核，但这不等于没有 DNA。点一下 DNA，看遗传物质在什么: Bacteria have no membrane-enclosed nucleus, but that does not mean they have no DNA. Tap DNA to see where their genetic material is.
细菌没有叶绿体。不过，有些细菌能用自己的光合结构进行光合作用，例如蓝细菌。: Bacteria have no chloroplasts. Some bacteria, such as cyanobacteria, can still photosynthesize using their own photosynthetic structures.
试着找：哪个细胞的 DNA 没有被细胞核包住？: Can you find the cell whose DNA is not enclosed in a nucleus?
有没有细胞核，能帮助我们分辨这几类细胞。: The presence or absence of a nucleus helps us distinguish these types of cells.
记住这个例外：植物的根部细胞通常没有叶绿体。: Remember this exception: plant root cells usually have no chloroplasts.
